name: Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana
briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 December 2017.
descriptionMd: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &amp;quot;Mukhyamantri Asangathit Karmakar Ijjat Monthly Season Ticket Card Yojana&amp;quot; for unorganized worker on 19 June 2017. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing travel pass for train.
benefitsMd: > Train pass for daily travel up to a maximum of 150 kilometers.
eligibilityMd:
1. Unorganized workers must be registered with the board.
1. If the Unorganized workers already received benefits from any other similar scheme of the state government, they will not be eligible for the benefits of this scheme.
